projects.title: Public Text Classification Course Project
bullets: Implemented a bag-of-words classifier for short public discussion-topic documents using Python and scikit-learn in a supervised undergraduate course project.
Cleaned public text records using pandas and compared classification errors across document lengths as part of the course project.

research.title: Public Bibliographic Data Query Performance
bullets: Loaded public bibliographic tables into a relational database using Python, SQL, and SQLite as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Documented query plans as part of supervised research on query performance for public bibliographic tabular data.
